sources.title: Introducing Perplexity Deep Research, official localized article
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened on October 27, 2026. Announces public web availability of Deep Research, iterative searches, document reading and reasoning to write cited reports. No total/active parameter count or named base model is identified. The official archive separately dates this article February 14, 2025.

sources.title: Perplexity official blog archive
sources.evidence: The Introducing Perplexity Deep Research article is explicitly dated February 14, 2025; inspected HTML time datetime 2025-02-14T00:00:00.000Z. This is the application launch, not the later API expansion.

sources.title: Perplexity CEO announces Deep Research through the Sonar API
sources.evidence: Accessed original post through X official oEmbed and syndication JSON after the normal page was inaccessible. created_at is 2025-02-25T19:36:24.000Z. The CEO says Perplexity is making Deep Research available as an endpoint to all developers through the Sonar API, establishing the existing application feature to API lineage; it does not assert identical checkpoints.

sources.title: Official X syndication data for the API announcement
sources.evidence: Returns the original author, complete announcement text, post identifier and February 25, 2025 creation timestamp. Author metadata carries a Perplexity business affiliation. Independent X oEmbed endpoint returns the same text and date.

sources.title: Perplexity API changelog
sources.evidence: Freshly retrieved on October 27, 2026. The March 2025 entry distinguishes Sonar Deep Research; May entries document exact sonar-deep-research reasoning_effort and asynchronous API controls. Later entries document migration to Agent API. No total/active parameter count or exact named-base relationship for the legacy Deep Research model appears; request parameters and inference effort are not model sizes.

sources.title: Sonar to Agent API migration documentation
sources.evidence: States Sonar Chat Completions support ended September 27, 2026. Synchronous and streaming calls continue via gradual reformulation into Agent API requests; asynchronous Sonar requests are no longer supported. Explicit mapping lists Sonar Deep Research to high effort. The new Agent API capabilities/model configurations do not establish specifications of the retired legacy model.

sources.title: March 19, 2025 Sonar model update
sources.evidence: Official dated article lists Sonar Deep Research as an existing distinct model exempted from the new high/medium/low search modes and citation-billing changes. This is family and named-identity corroboration, not a new release or a parameter disclosure.

sources.title: OpenRouter Sonar Deep Research endpoint specification
sources.evidence: Provider page identifies the exact model, 128,000-token context and text input/output. It describes repeated searches, reasoning and synthesis. March 7, 2025 is this provider listing date and does not supersede the earlier developer launch. Page says custom tools are not accepted; this differs from built-in research/search use.

sources.title: OpenRouter exact endpoint metadata
sources.evidence: Exact Perplexity endpoint lists context_length 128000 and text-to-text modalities. supported_parameters contains reasoning and web_search_options, not tools. The generic supports_tool_choice flags conflict with that list and are not used to claim custom function support. instruct_type deepseek-r1 is a formatting label, not proof that this exact hosted model uses an unchanged DeepSeek checkpoint.

sources.title: Perplexity API terms, January 23, 2026
sources.evidence: Terms explicitly cover Sonar and Agentic Research API services. Section 2.1 grants limited service-use rights; section 3.1 reserves Perplexity/licensor rights to models, algorithms and associated software. Supports the descriptive Proprietary service classification, not an open checkpoint license.

sources.title: DRACO first-party technical report, February 12, 2026
sources.evidence: Freshly fetched the complete 38-page original PDF on October 27, 2026; reread section 5.1 and Tables 8-10, and visually inspected page 9. Section 5.1 identifies the production Perplexity web endpoint with Opus 4.5 or 4.6 base models, not legacy sonar-deep-research. Tables report scores, token usage and latency, not total/active parameters. Full-text parameter/backend search found no counted legacy-model relationship.

sources.title: Perplexity RL training research
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened the original Perplexity research article on October 27, 2026. Its introduction explicitly presents smaller open-model experiments as illustrations whose lessons inform production. The training experiments do not identify exact sonar-deep-research weights, a named-base relationship or its total/active count, so their sizes are not transferred.

sources.title: Perplexity speculative decoding research
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened the original article on October 27, 2026. It discusses Sonar acceleration with a separately fine-tuned Llama-1B draft, Llama-70B examples, MTP heads and mechanisms for DeepSeek-scale models. These statements do not identify the exact Sonar Deep Research target or a counted base relationship. Draft/head sizes and prospective mechanisms are not the legacy model total or active count.

sources.title: Perplexity official public model listing
sources.evidence: Queried the official author inventory, which returned 27 public repositories and no Sonar Deep Research checkpoint. Together with the hosted service documentation and proprietary terms this supports retaining closed weights; other Perplexity releases are not this model.

sources.title: Legacy exact-model documentation URL
sources.evidence: The old model URL now redirects to the migration overview, so its former architecture/context body was not available. Do not treat the redirect as an accessed historical model card.

sources.title: Retained Sonar Deep Research model documentation
sources.evidence: Freshly retrieved directly with HTTP 200 on October 27, 2026. The retained exact sonar-deep-research card documents 128K context, research/reasoning, searches and billing, but no total or active parameter count and no named underlying checkpoint. Its long sample response describes quantum-computing market sizes, which are not model parameters. The card is retained for continued Sonar access and links Agent API migration.

sources.title: Meet the new Sonar: exact basic-Sonar lineage
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27, 2026. The February 11 launch explicitly identifies Sonar for default search as further trained from Llama 3.3 70B Instruct. It does not identify Sonar Deep Research as that variant. This is valid nominal lineage evidence for the named basic Sonar model, not a family-wide parameter disclosure.

sources.title: Retained Sonar Reasoning Pro card: distinct model identity
sources.evidence: Freshly retrieved October 27, 2026. The card identifies sonar-reasoning-pro separately, with 128K context and chain-of-thought features, but does not state that sonar-deep-research is the same checkpoint or a variant. The current card itself does not name DeepSeek R1; the provider attribution to Reasoning Pro must not be transferred to Deep Research.

sources.title: FinDeepForecast: original deep-research benchmark, January 2026
sources.publisher: Xiangyu Li et al. / National University of Singapore and collaborators
sources.evidence: Freshly downloaded the full 44-page original paper on October 27, 2026. Table 18 on page 37, also visually inspected, explicitly maps Perplexity Sonar Deep Research to sonar-deep-research with high reasoning effort. Comparison results and settings do not provide a total/active parameter column or counted base mapping. Full-text searches for model size, parameters and activation did not reveal such a count; API settings and task statistics are not parameters.

sources.title: DR Tulu: original model-team research, May 2026 revision
sources.publisher: Rulin Shao et al. / Ai2, University of Washington and collaborators
sources.evidence: Freshly downloaded the full 56-page v3 paper on October 27, 2026. Table 1 on page 5, visually inspected, lists Perplexity Deep Research with benchmark scores, while Table 5 lists sizes for open research models and omits a Perplexity count. Its performance/cost tables and full-text parameter search do not establish a total/active count or named base for the exact legacy API model. General claims of smaller open models are not numeric parameter disclosures.

sources.title: Tongyi DeepResearch Technical Report, May 2026 revision
sources.evidence: Freshly downloaded the full 23-page v3 report on October 27, 2026 and inspected its comparison/model-scale sections and searched all text for Perplexity/Sonar and parameter counts. The stated 30.5B total and 3.3B activated counts belong to Tongyi; no exact Sonar Deep Research row or parameter count was found. It supplies no transferable active-count convention for this model.

name.note: Exact published Sonar API model identity; not the newer Agent API high effort configuration.

developer.note: Perplexity develops and offers this research system; no undocumented underlying-model author is substituted.

family.note: Explicit Sonar family grouping, normalized lowercase; this does not assert common weights with Sonar, Pro or Reasoning Pro.

release_date.note: Earliest public Deep Research application launch is February 14, 2025. The CEO February 25 announcement explicitly makes that existing Deep Research capability available through the Sonar API, establishing product/model lineage without proving an identical checkpoint. February 25 is API expansion; March 7 is OpenRouter listing. The baseline February 1 date has no primary support.

open_weights.note: Hosted proprietary research system; no exact public checkpoint in the accessed developer release materials or official public model inventory. Do not inherit openness from Sonar base-model ancestry, R1-1776 or newer Perplexity releases.

license.note: Descriptive classification under the Sonar API service terms, not an SPDX identifier or open-weight license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 re-audit found no published nominal total or explicit named-base relationship for exact legacy sonar-deep-research. Reopened original cards, launch/changelog and Perplexity research, then searched exact-model total/size/base terms and later original research tables. Basic Sonar Llama lineage, Reasoning Pro backend descriptions, draft models and later Opus web agents do not identify this model.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 search separately checked activated/active parameters and later original model-team tables, including DR Tulu and Tongyi, plus the exact API mapping in FinDeepForecast. No nominal active count or accounting convention was found for this model. Inference effort, reasoning tokens, search counts and costs are not activated parameters; no dense-total equality or sibling count is inferred.

architecture.note: Neural topology of this exact hosted research system remains undisclosed in accessed evidence. Iterative search/reasoning is an agent workflow, not a dense/MoE/Transformer architecture specification. Generic Sonar Transformer speculation research and OpenRouter instruct_type deepseek-r1 lack an exact backend binding; later web Deep Research Opus configurations are separate evidence.

context_window.note: Developer retained exact-model card documents nominal 128K context; the serving provider specifies 128,000 for this endpoint. This is the documented legacy API limit, not a claim of neural maximum or unchanged backend after migration.

modalities.note: Exact endpoint exposes text input and generated text. Citations, source URLs and document/report export are application metadata or formats. No image, audio or PDF-native neural input inferred from the broader application or replacement Agent API.

reasoning.note: Explicit exact sonar-deep-research reasoning_effort controls and reasoning-token behavior; original Deep Research description explains repeated planning and evidence synthesis.

tool_call.note: Verified built-in autonomous web-search use within the research workflow. This field includes built-in tools; it does not promise caller-defined function calls. The documented provider endpoint does not accept a tools schema, and replacement Agent API custom/MCP capabilities are not backported.

description.value: Research model that performs repeated web searches and produces reports with citations.
description.note: Replaces broad promotional wording with the documented research and cited-report behavior. Retirement and API remapping are recorded in notes.

patch.notes: Deep Research launched in the web app on February 14, 2025 and expanded to the Sonar API on February 25; OpenRouter listed it March 7. This establishes product lineage, not identical checkpoints. Total/active parameters and exact neural architecture are undisclosed; basic Sonar, Reasoning Pro and later Opus web-agent specifications do not establish this model’s counts. The developer specifies nominal 128K context and the provider 128,000 tokens. Tool use means built-in searches; the provider does not support custom function calls. Sonar support ended September 27, 2026: synchronous/streaming calls migrate to Agent API requests and legacy asynchronous requests are unsupported.

summary: Preserved the other 12 field assessments. Fresh October 27 parameter re-audit reopened exact legacy documentation, release/changelog and Perplexity research, and inspected later FinDeepForecast, DR Tulu and Tongyi original research tables. No total or active count or named counted-base relationship was established for exact sonar-deep-research. Both fields remain undisclosed with explicit null patch values and parameters_source null; sibling and replacement-model counts are not transferred.
